title: What is machine control in construction and how does it work?
summary: Machine control uses sensors, GNSS, and 3D digital models to provide heavy equipment operators with real-time, in-cab guidance. By connecting office designs directly to field operations, it boosts accuracy, automates tasks, and reduces manual rework.
